_comment: Two ways a granted permission is still blocked or blind. (1) DENY: breaker@demo.com is granted setIamPolicy on '*' but a deny policy removes it on projects/locked — deny wins there. (2) EXEMPTION: secretmanager.versions.access has a single audit method, and even though Data Access logging is ON for Secret Manager, that method is listed in disabled_methods — an explicit exemption blinds it anyway. (Note: exempting works cleanly here because the permission has ONE method spelling; a permission with several spellings, like logging.sinks.delete, would need all of them exempted.)
_expect: candidates load examples/candidates_medium.decn   (then)   account load examples/accounts/07_deny_and_exemption.json   (blindspots needs a library loaded)
ask blindspots resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy  ->  reachable; a witness avoids projects/locked because the deny wins there.

ask blindspots secretmanager.versions.access  ->  1 unlogged: Data Access logging is on, but the AccessSecretVersion method is exempted in disabled_methods, so it is never recorded. This is the 'someone turned logging off for this method' blind spot.
Contrast with 03 (whole-service data-access off) — same silence, different cause (a targeted exemption vs the service-wide default).
name: deny-and-exemption
